bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (share sheet to installed apps), springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLRequest, URLSession); no social-network service
summary: Apple's Social framework composes a post to a social network and signs HTTP requests with the user's social account. BifrOSt has a share sheet that passes text, URLs and files to installed apps and a generic HTTP client, but no service that posts to social networks and no social account store.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/compose.rs (ComposeSheet), springboard/sdk/src/social.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/compose_sheet.rs, springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs (Compose Post target), springboard/ui/src/compose.rs
features.note: Wave 6 (b06, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. The share menu hands items to installed apps. It does not show an editor that posts to a network. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.
Wave 3 (theme-30, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No service types exist to check.

features.apple: setInitialText(_:), add(_:) for images and URLs, removeAllImages(), removeAllURLs()
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (Payload::Text, Url, File; at most 8 items); wired: springboard/src/shell/compose_sheet.rs (sheet_for, hand_off_text)
features.note: Items can be passed to the share menu, but no post composer edits or attaches them. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (App::share_done via show_picker); springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/compose_sheet.rs (compose_done), springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs (share_finish)
features.note: Reports the chosen app id, 'copy', or None when dismissed. It has no posted, cancelled or done states. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: HTTP request assembly for a service
features.note: Generic HTTP exists. No service-typed request, no parameter encoding and no multipart body (none found in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/src).
Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The SDK URL code has no multipart builder.
No account store and no OAuth or token signing. BifrOSt Cloud accounts live in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud, outside this repo.

features.feature: Receiving shared content in an extension
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (manifest handles and schemes; Input::Open; App::document)
features.note: An app can receive shared URLs, text and files. There is no separate extension process.
Named third-party networks, several of them defunct. Tied to Apple's service list, not to a desktop capability.

gaps: No compose sheet that posts to a social network (SLComposeViewController equivalent).
No social account store or request signing (SLRequest.account equivalent).
No service-typed HTTP request builder and no multipart body (SLRequest equivalent).
The share menu offers only installed apps, with no per-item NSSharingService objects or delegate callbacks (see docs/bifrost-ui.md, 'Share sheet' gaps).
